name: Michael Gahler - Après le § 31 - Am 6
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: 31c. Expresses concern over the non-respect of the same phytosanitary standards, plant protection and animal welfare rules in Ukraine as those applicable to European farmers, and over the increasing concentration of agricultural land in Ukraine in the hands of investment funds operating large-scale mega-farms, a model that is fundamentally at odds with the family-farming structure that underpins European agriculture;
